TCP system calls are enabled only for granted TCP wires; socket family/type/protocol constrained.
Typed-cap-call dispatch checks each wire admission before its handler.
Wire47 internal bit48 cannot alias legacy state bit47; effect and project declaration refusals exercised.
Catalog explicitly retains the ordinary host-process authority and bounded unary spawn semantics.
